image_description: A high-angle landscape photograph featuring a massive, steep cliff face with vertical columnar jointing (likely basalt). The foreground consists of a grassy, vegetated plateau edge leading to the drop-off. In the background, rolling green hills and distant mountains are visible under a partly cloudy sky. A river or valley floor is visible at the base of the cliff on the right side.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visual structure (columnar jointing) strongly suggests basalt (volcanic), not granite, limestone, or sandstone. Therefore, the specific compositional claim in the checkpoint does not align with the visual evidence.
